parsed.rationale: Both participating records are methods named `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveArtist` residing in test-target files (`Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` and `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift`). Although the pipeline emitted `is_test=false` and `is_mock=false` for both, the file paths (under `Tests/MetadataTests/` and `Tests/WXYCTests/`) and the `Mock`-prefixed type name `MockDiscogsEntityResolver` unambiguously identify these as test-fixture helpers. Lifting a shared mock into production-visible shared code would couple test semantics into the production dependency graph, which is the canonical restraint pattern. No refactor is warranted without first establishing a dedicated test-support library that neither production target depends on.
